installedDependency.evidence: Parent retained utel098-canonical-apply-root01 and utel098-canonical-plan-root01; not requalified by these synthetic tests

ActivityUsageAttribution.Classification.direct: same-invocation exact native usage join; not a purpose
ActivityUsageAttribution.Classification.mixed: unknown purpose unless supported conserved allocation

canonicalMappings.mappingStatus: Legacy cause maps are candidate vocabulary only, never establish supported inference, avoidability or purpose. Preserve the original value and source revision.
canonicalMappings.ProcessReview: Existing bounded private prose and coverage retained; final assessment references an admitted item review. Provisional delivery never enters this record.
canonicalMappings.NativeItemOutcome: source-merged observation keyed by repository/PR/mergeCommit; disputed source remains visibly disputed; does not establish installed adoption or native population completeness.
canonicalMappings.BudgetAttribution: dimension/provider/accountingScope/sourceRef joins are preserved; classified/mixed/unclassified never automatically map to necessity.
canonicalMappings.BudgetInterval: administrative/useful/productive and useful-test exclusion remain under TelemetryBudget authority; no efficiency purpose remaps its verdict.
canonicalMappings.Correction: TelemetryCi correction plan/apply/history already at protected schema13; current_ingest_facts and current_* views select effective item. Preserve original immutable records and canonical reducer authority.

populationRules.outcomeEpoch: null unless an explicit witnessed outcome/reopen sequence establishes the epoch; no existing native reopen epoch producer was found at the inspected revision. .2 must join immutable outcome refs and witnessed sequence; never default to1 or confuse budget epoch with outcome epoch. Late usage/analysis does not advance it.
populationRules.nativeItem: Existing engine eligibility requires complete expected dispatch lineage, terminal and qualified usage populations. The extension cannot mint eligibility.
populationRules.provisionalDelivery: Known source outcome with incomplete/unknown runtime population; visible source count, unknown whole-item cost, never native completion or first-pass denominator.
populationRules.cohort: Explicit item IDs, work type, repository, acceptance scope, window and cutoff; costs include unsuccessful, cancelled, abandoned and open exposure plus allocated shared and analyst cost.
populationRules.zeroAccepted: Cost-per-accepted denominator zero => value null, status not-applicable; preserve observed cost.
populationRules.revisionSelection: Select greatest canonical source revision per stable source identity at cutoff, not newest ingestion timestamp; identical identity/revision/bytes replay is deduplicated; conflicting same revision => unknown and no efficiency claim.
populationRules.correction: Consume supported append-only current selection. Old and replacement attribution retained in audit, exactly one current contribution and outcome. Duplicate correction replay contributes zero additional cost/outcomes.
populationRules.legacyCorrection: If installed support is unavailable report correction-unsupported and unresolved lineage; no SQL edits or fabricated replacement outcome.

allocationRules.resourceIdentity: Stable native usage or CI run/job identity plus dimension/provider/accountingScope; deduplicate before allocation.
allocationRules.tokenSemantics: total = input + output; cachedInput is an input subset, reasoning an output subset; cacheWriteInput separate, never added to native total without a provider definition.
allocationRules.conservation: Each source amount is allocated by exact rational shares; sum shares <= 1. Remainder is unallocated; do not duplicate shared CI or round before aggregation.
allocationRules.purposes: Exclusive per resource unit. Supported split shares may populate purposes; unsupported mixed/unclassified remains unknown. Repair/activity/cause views intersect these buckets and are not additive.
allocationRules.avoidable: Only observed or supported-inference claim with evidence and feasible then-permitted alternative enters numerator; hypotheses excluded. Required duplicate checks remain required.
allocationRules.causeCost: One episode amount counted once under supported exclusive primary cause. Contributing causes are nonexclusive counts, not additive costs.
allocationRules.time: Observed span sum is separate from elapsed union clipped to witnessed item window. Wait union separate; overlaps explicit. Missing span time is unknown, never inferred wait. Critical-path claims need witnessed dependency coverage.

delivered-outcomes.numerator: unique current outcomes in selected stage

observed-resource.numerator: deduplicated measured usage plus conserved allocated shared usage

avoidable-share.denominator: observed-resource; unknown classification remains in denominator

retry-incidence.numerator: logical operations with >1 witnessed executed attempts
retry-incidence.denominator: operations with fully known attempt population; observation replay excluded

retry-burden.numerator: additional executed attempt resource, same-input and changed-input reported separately
retry-burden.denominator: total same-resource cohort usage; missing attempts => partial

first-pass-delivery.numerator: accepted items on first eligible attempt
first-pass-delivery.denominator: items with fully observed terminal attempt populations; excluded/open/abandoned disclosed

churn.numerator: reopens/handoff returns/repeated stage visits/invalidated proofs separately

lead-time.numerator: native outcome time minus native start time

touch-time.numerator: union of witnessed touch intervals clipped to item window

wait-time.numerator: union of witnessed wait intervals; overlaps retained

critical-path-delay.numerator: delay on witnessed dependency path, concurrent waits not summed

cost-per-accepted.numerator: all attributable cohort resource including unsuccessful attempts and analyst

analysis-burden.numerator: all analyst usage including failures, subset of observed-resource

data-health.numerator: expected/observed producer populations and unresolved gaps; producer, ingestion, publication ages separate
data-health.denominator: explicit expected population or null if unknown

policyProfiles.definition: O/(P+O), with planning/review/coordination/delivery/shared-flow maintenance and 30-day attributed repairs included under existing P/O policy; useful assurance never relabeled direct product
policyProfiles.authority: efficiency claim only; does not gate OpenV2/OperatingV2
policyProfiles.aliasStatus: New selected efficiency contract alias for the existing accepted policy; not a preexisting wire identifier.

policyProfiles.definition: existing dimension/provider/accountingScope numerator/denominator; useful-test exclusion retained
policyProfiles.aliasStatus: New selected efficiency contract alias for existing TelemetryBudget policy; not a preexisting wire identifier.

assessmentRules.idempotencyEncoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON array in listed order, ensure_ascii=true
assessmentRules.revision: positive per assessmentId; append-only, greatest canonical revision current; supersedes links earlier assessment, preserves history
assessmentRules.finalization: native-item ready requires existing admitted item review reference and complete runtime population; references prior provisional assessment without adding an outcome
assessmentRules.reopen: prior epoch assessments historical; prior costs remain cohort exposure
assessmentRules.numericFacts: all measured numbers resolve metricRefs; analyst cannot supply measured cost or duration
assessmentRules.trigger: exclude analysis-generated facts from substantive evidence digest; include analyst cost in deterministic metrics
assessmentRules.publication: private by default; this contract grants no free-text public approval; .4 defines approved structured projection
assessmentRules.unknownEpoch: Pending/partial only when epoch is null; cannot qualify final ready or claim current-versus-historical reopened outcome selection.
assessmentRules.primaryCause: Exclusive supported primary cause must be unknown for hypothesis/unknown claims; hypotheses may retain contributing causes explicitly as proposals, excluded from supported cause charts.

migration.mode: additive versioned sidecar contracts; no new ingest/1 kind activated by .1
migration.legacy: retain all existing records, readers, vocabulary and budget policies; do not reinterpret old prose as labeled findings
migration.unsupportedVersion: explicit incompatible state, retain last valid snapshot; never empty successful feed
migration.store: No migration selected here; .2 owns storage implementation using existing supported correction; qualify installed versions independently
migration.externalTraceReason: No new OCEL/OpenTelemetry/FOCUS adapter selected; explicit object joins only. An actual adapter must pin its convention before activation.
